events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Manning threw for three touchdowns and Edgerrin James continued his big season as the Colts remained unbeaten with a 31-17 triumph over the Texans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning, Colts pound woeful Texans to stay unbeaten

events.name: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Bill Belichick and the injury-riddled New England Patriots still beat Saban's Miami Dolphins 23-16 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady's late TD pass helps Pats squeak by Dolphins
